# shumoku_data_source (Data Source)

Looks up a configured data source by `id` or by exact `name`, e.g. to attach one that is managed outside Terraform. Its configuration (which holds secrets) is not exposed. Requires an `admin` API token.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Attach a data source that is managed outside Terraform.
data "shumoku_data_source" "netbox" {
  name = "NetBox"
}

resource "shumoku_topology_source" "netbox" {
  topology_id    = data.shumoku_topology.campus.id
  data_source_id = data.shumoku_data_source.netbox.id
  purpose        = "topology"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Data source id.
- `name` (String) Exact data source name.

### Read-Only

- `status` (String) `connected`, `disconnected` or `unknown`.
- `type` (String) Plugin type.
